selection_rule.strata: v3 historical no-skill mean refactor score: floor == 0, middle in (0,1), ceiling == 1 (from benchmarks/generator-skill-effect-v3/protocol.json screening)
selection_rule.method: random.Random(seed).sample over the ID-sorted stratum, strata drawn in the order floor, middle, ceiling; final list sorted

load.note: v8 inherited 20; the maintainer asked for 40 on this shared host. Scoring uses the same threshold.

official_arm.initializer: npx --no-install playwright init-agents --loop=codex, run inside each official-arm workspace on the host with the frozen fixture Playwright 1.62.0 (docs verify 1.62.1; 1.62.0 is the fixture version and supports the command, probed before freeze)
official_arm.unavailable_rule: A cell is UNAVAILABLE, never an app failure, when init-agents exits nonzero, omits the generator definition, or its three agent-file digests differ from the frozen ones. No model call is made for it. It is reported separately and excluded from the available-only view; the as-run view scores it 0.
official_arm.invocation: Codex parent (gpt-5.5, medium) is told to spawn the initialized playwright_test_generator custom agent natively with specs/plan.md and tests/seed.spec.ts, not to hand-write specs, not to use the planner or healer, and may run the written files once without editing them.
official_arm.engagement_proxy: Parent transcripts do not expose child MCP tool calls, so engagement is reported by a file-signature proxy: every delivered spec carries the first-party `// spec:` and `// seed:` header comments. This is a proxy, not proof of tool use.

ours_arm.snapshot: skills/playwright-test-generator and skills/e2e-reviewer (evals/ excluded) from base commit f83962e9 (release/2.0.1), tree-digested in freeze.json; staged under /work/skill and invoked with the v8 SKILL_LINE
ours_arm.note: v8's `full-fixed` snapshot is NOT used; this arm is the 2.0.1 release skill.

shared_inputs.plan: benchmarks/generator-official-pilot-v1/plans/<case>/plan.md, derived mechanically (runner write-plans) from the v3 task text: overview = verbatim brief; each sentence after a bare 'Cover ...' scope sentence becomes one scenario with the sentence as step and expected result. Both arms receive the identical file plus the identical tests/seed.spec.ts (init-agents seed with `await page.goto('/')` added) and the identical PLAN_LINE appended to the brief.
shared_inputs.frame: v8/v3 FRAME unchanged (approvals, deliverable rules, JSON schema). Arm-specific line differs only in the generator instruction. Official arm also gets the per-row approval for `npx playwright run-test-mcp-server`.
shared_inputs.workspace_difference: Official arm additionally contains .codex/agents/*.toml and specs/README.md from init-agents. Both are committed in the baseline so they are not counted as writes.

scoring: Unchanged v3 engine and v8 shared scanner snapshot: clean x3, 5 seeded-fault kills, one markup refactor (primary), scanner counts, flaky clean runs, plus a text probe for weakening constructs (test.skip/fixme, empty catch, expect(true), toBeTruthy, waitForTimeout). Scoring runs on the macOS host as in v8.
primary: Per-cell markup-refactor survival (1 only if clean 3/3 and refactor passes). Guards: clean-all-three rate, effective fault kill, scanner P0 and P1/P2 counts. Also recorded: flaky scoring calls, generation seconds (setup excluded), parent-reported token usage.
decision: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY. No PASS/FAIL, no confidence interval, no significance claim. Per-task paired outcomes (official minus ours) and as-run plus available-only views are reported.

evidence_interpretation.counts_as_suggestive: Same sign on the refactor-survival difference in at least 5 of 6 tasks with both guards not worse for the same arm; this only motivates a full run.
evidence_interpretation.counts_as_nothing: Anything else, including a 3-3 split, a single-task swing, or differences carried by UNAVAILABLE or blocked cells.
evidence_interpretation.weakening: Reported as the union of scanner P0 hits, weakening-text-probe hits, clean-passing specs that leave a stated-behavior fault unkilled (faults_escaped) and any manual transcript reading, each labeled by method; absence of a hit is not a proof of no weakening.

stop_rules: Pause and retry when `uptime` load average (1 min) exceeds 40, up to 1800 s per wait (engine wait_for_load threshold set to 40); never more than one model call at a time.

Stop on any infrastructure error after the inherited single retry, on usage/rate limits, on disk below 4 GiB, or on any digest drift. The partial report is preserved and the resume command is `run --allow-live --resume --output <same path>`.
Never edit this protocol, runner, plans or freeze after the first scheduled call; a change needs a successor protocol.

preflight.purpose: Two unscheduled setup calls on task v2-01 (not in the pilot set), run before freeze: one per arm. They proved the container, init-agents, agent spawn and scoring pipeline work. Results: official arm delivered 5 spec files in 216.7 s, clean 3/3, refactor survived, effective kill 0.8 (one fault missed); ours delivered 1 spec in 530.3 s, clean 3/3, refactor survived, kill 1.0. These are setup evidence, not pilot data, and were not used to choose tasks, arms or metrics. They did cause two fixes before freeze: the adapter's event-census merge and the file-signature engagement proxy.

limits: 6 public development tasks x 2 repetitions: 12 cells per arm, 6 task clusters. Nothing here is a release or a general accuracy claim.

One host/model (Codex CLI 0.159.3, gpt-5.5, medium) in a Linux container; the official generator is designed for its own agent loop, and the Codex custom-agent path is one of several documented hosts.

The frozen plan is a mechanical transform of a brief. It is not what the official planner would write and it may under- or over-constrain either arm; the 2.0.1 skill normally designs its own scenarios.
Parent JSON usage excludes child agents' tokens for both arms, so token totals undercount the official arm (generation happens in a child) and ours (reviewer children) by unknown amounts.
Engagement of the official generator's MCP tools is inferred from a file signature, not observed.
Healer, planner, and Playwright 1.62.1 were not part of this pilot; the fixture pins 1.62.0.
Scoring uses the v3 author-written faults and a single id/class refactor per task; task selection used historical no-skill results for strata only.
full_run_requirements: All 36 validated tasks x 3 repetitions x 2 arms = 216 calls (~several hours of model time at v8 per-call times), a sealed or externally held task pool for any release claim, the planner-produced plan as an additional arm, and a stop on a pre-set paired decision rule; at paired SD 0.35 the detectable lift at 80% power with 36 tasks is about 0.16.
